args.lesson: Area-dominated CORDIC spec (min luts_plus_ffs, >=1 MSPS, err<=2^-10): one full 400-eval run_dse is enough. The whole 36-design feasible front came out iterative-family; the min-area corner sits at data_width=15, n_iter=16, angle_guard=1, frac_guard=0, rounding=round (luts_plus_ffs=260 est, luts=168, ffs=92, throughput 10.4 MSPS est, max_abs_err=0.000632 exact = 2^-10.63). Extra accuracy comes cheap in area (angle_guard/frac_guard/rounding tweaks: 260->288 buys ~1 bit) so the front is nearly flat on the area axis. L2 was a no-op (spec has no system scenario) though simulate_system still returned a DDS SFDR/SNR fact; L3/L4/L5 returned no_measured_data for this design and no winner change, so reexplore was not warranted.
